title: Add settingsRepository field and settings StateFlow to DailyListViewModel
description: Wires SettingsRepository into the ViewModel alongside the existing repositories, and exposes its settings Flow as a StateFlow the same way activeProfiles/activeMedications are exposed.
acceptance_criteria: private val settingsRepository = SettingsRepository(application) is added as a field on DailyListViewModel
val settings: StateFlow<AppSettings> is added, built from settingsRepository.settings.stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), AppSettings())
